description: This file defines an abstract class 'Table' for representing data tables within a software project related to ECU tuning and data visualization. It includes methods for managing table data, scaling, highlighting, copying, interpolating, and comparison functionalities, and integrates with UI components and external utilities.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: An abstract class representing a data table used in ECU tuning interface, managing data cells, scales, UI interactions, and comparison features.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Abstract method to render the table visually.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Abstract method to populate table data from byte array input.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Abstract method to increment table data by a value.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Abstract method to multiply table data by a factor.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor up within the table.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor down within the table.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor left within the table.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Abstract method to move cursor right within the table.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize table data into byte array form for saving.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Abstract method to perform horizontal interpolation on table data.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if live data support is enabled for this table.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a UI button related to this table is selected.
